class FastScanner {

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {

                m /= 10;
                res += (c - '0') * m;

        return res * sgn;
    }

    bool isExhausted() {
        int value;
        while (isSpaceChar(value = peek()) && value != -1) {

    string next() {

void shuffle(vector<int>& a) {
    random_device rd;
    mt19937 gen(rd());
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        uniform_int_distribution<> dis(0, a.size() - 1);
        int r = dis(gen);
        int temp = a[i];
        a[i] = a[r];
        a[r] = temp;
    }
}
